newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bourse, Belfox, clearer consider merger.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bourse, Belfox, clearer consider merger.

text.p: The Brussels bourse, Belgian futures and options exchange Belfox and securites clearing house CIK are investigating a merger, they said on Thursday.

A merger is being considered with a view to creating a unified strategy, strengthening the position of Belgian markets within the context of European integration and a more eficient use of technical and human resources to boost the competitive capabilities of Brussels as a financial centre.
The organisations said that as a first step they had decided to allow the same people to sit their respective boards.
An external consultant had been commissioned to study the realisation of the merger project. A working party would report to the boards of the organisations before October 31.

Belgian daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd said earlier on Thursday the merger would be modelled on that earlier this year of the bourse and the EOE derivatives exchange in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
